text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Mejiro Ardan
have come
to an end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In this moment, she stands as a central
figure of
the era, poised at the cutting
edge of history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And as long as she has her cherished
rivals, she'll
keep on going, well into the
future.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the constellation of tracks she
leaves
behind, those who look upon her
must see a
brilliant, shimmering river...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Might I ask you to join me for a while?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's my day off and Mejiro Ardan has
appeared at
my door. She makes this
sudden request without
breaking eye
contact...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There's a car waiting out front. Please
come out
once you're ready.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With no idea what's going on, I hastily
gather my
things before heading off with
Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The view here is spectacular regardless
of when
one visits. It's ever so calming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's nanny has driven us to a
small hill
near the Mejiro family's rest
house.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Do you remember this spot, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's where you first indicated my
path to the
future.
choice_data_list: 君にロードマップを見せた場所だな
貴方にロードマップを見せた場所だね

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's where the person I am now got her
start.

text_block_list.name: Nanny
text_block_list.text:
My lady. Everything's ready now, so I'll
begin
unpacking over here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Nanny.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you allow me to paint a picture
of you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, a picture.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...As we've walked this path together
over the
past three years, you've given
me a great many
things, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
And every single one has become a
precious
memory that I intend to hold
onto tightly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Which is what made me realize that I'd
quite like
something physical to
immortalize our time
together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The idea that came to mind... was
something I
used to do to pass the hours
while in the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That feeling I had when you showed me
the future
here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: And the way I feel right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I want to capture those feelings here, in
a picture.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Would you... be willing to grant me this
selfish
request?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: とりあえず、ポーズを取ればいいのかな

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then, I may proceed?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan treasures whatever it is she
most
wants to do in the moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's something I swore to respect
during our
three years together. Why
would I reject it now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.
choice_data_list: 俺は、君のトレーナーだから
私は、貴方のトレーナーだから

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder just how many times those
words have been a
pillar of strength for
me since we've met...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Since all the materials are here, why not
paint
something yourself, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two of us paint each other, then
swap once
we're finished.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The picture Mejiro Ardan paints is so
sublime and
mystifying I can hardly
believe it's me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As for the painting I put my heart and
soul into,
Mejiro Ardan says she plans to
frame and hang it
up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We end up reminiscing about the past
three
years, and the sun sets without us
even realizing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Have I... left a lasting impression on you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Are things the same as they were when
last you
spoke to me here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Does my future still exist... within you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that future is here, for sure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan has made a deep
impression on my
heart. It's there right
now, and it'll be there for as
long as I
live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm gone, the trail of light
tracing
Mejiro Ardan's path will surely
illuminate the
future for generations to
come.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's right. In my eyes, Mejiro Ardan
has always
been...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: 君は俺にとって、“永遠”の輝きだ
貴方は私にとって、“永遠”の輝きだよ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: That's unfair.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I mean, that would make me the only
one who's
going to last until the end of
time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I dislike that notion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Which is why...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I shall shape both your present and your
future.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Just as you have for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
So long as I draw breath, I shall continue
to carve
out your path.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If I am eternal in your eyes, and I trace
each of
your moments, now and
forever...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Then, surely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
They'll form an eternity, for the two of
us alone.
